note: This file is a design draft only. It is not a freeze, it has no batch, and no paid request may be made under it. The v12 development pilot already showed that paying to tune a regex on a task that participated in earlier tuning is not acceptable; this draft therefore stops before any request until every item in required_before_freeze is satisfied and a separate final freeze file is written once.

prescreen_alignment.accepted_premise: 'candidate old units != 0' does not predict an acceptable benefit; the design may not rest on candidate counts

counterexamples_openai_host.reading: zero candidates screen the batch out
non-zero candidates, benefit appears, quality collapses
non-zero candidates, small benefit, quality still drops

counterexamples_openai_host.strict_failure_cause: answer length (208 > 160), a model-side wording difference
counterexamples_openai_host.reading: clean mechanism gate plus non-zero candidates still did not preserve strict quality

two_numbers_must_be_reported_separately.potential_old_units_upper_bound: older units the frozen rule may touch, before guards
two_numbers_must_be_reported_separately.guard_filtered_safe_candidates: units surviving all five guard checks, counted on the deciding (final) boundary of the real payload

guard_checks: every distinct source keeps one full copy
the id-free tool-group hash is unchanged
every source pointer resolves to a newer full copy inside the same payload
no restore or whole-payload fallback, and none unaccounted

rules.non_zero_candidates: no benefit or quality prediction may be made from the count
rules.mechanism_side_channel: invariant gate only; a loss or an unaccounted fallback means fix the mechanism, never re-judge quality
rules.model_side_channel: the two quality tracks; must be measured, never inferred
rules.payment_path: sequential gates: evidence -> exposure -> non-zero safe-candidate space -> invariant -> pilot/confirmation

invariant_gate.stop_rule: any loss or unaccounted fallback stops the gate and requires a mechanism fix; a clean gate never upgrades a quality verdict

payload_acquisition_run.reason_not_executed: the evidence gate (prescreen section 2, item 1) cannot be satisfied this round, and paying before it is satisfied is forbidden by that gate
blocking_evidence: no public instance in this repository is unused by all three hosts: the ten instances under .tooling/swebench-verified/ belong either to this host's v1-v12 tasks (django-16263, pylint-8898, pytest-10356) or are referenced by OpenHands protocols/validators (django-15563, 15957, 16032, 16100, 16315, 16661, 17084)

acquiring a fresh instance needs a checkout or source fetch: git is forbidden this round, raw.githubusercontent.com resolves to 0.0.0.0 on this machine, and github.com/.../raw/... redirects there without being followed
the github.com blob HTML page returns only page chrome and is truncated, so it cannot serve as a hash-recorded baseline source
payload_acquisition_run.what_unblocks_it: a bounded checkout (or restored raw source access) so Stage 0 can record the instance file and baseline source SHA256

held_out_basis.evidence: grep for 'psf/requests', 'psf__requests' and 'requests-1766' over integrations/, experiments/, tests/, tasks/ returns 0 matches

candidate_task.title: quote qop options in Digest Auth
candidate_task.public_basis: RFC2617: the qop-options directive is a quoted string of one or more tokens; curl sends it quoted
candidate_task.selection_rule: selected only after Stage 0 acquires the instance file and the public baseline source with recorded SHA256; otherwise fall through to the next candidate

views.V1: public baseline source range that covers the cause-carrying function
views.rule: at least one view must carry every registered literal verbatim

task_shape.read_protocol: two rounds, one tool call per turn, V1 -> V2 -> V3 twice = 6 calls, answer only after the sixth output
task_shape.sent_data: public issue text and selected public baseline source ranges only; no reference patch, no host test patch, no local secret, no expected answer

track_A_strict.pattern_state: must be frozen at Stage 0 from the public issue text and baseline source
track_A_strict.order_and_boundary: tokens in order, separated only by the separators the pattern allows

track_B_semantic.role: diagnostic secondary track; reported separately and never merged with track A
track_B_semantic.matching: word-boundary ordered token search, field-local separators may be any non-alphanumeric characters
track_B_semantic.applicability_boundary: Track B may only cover wording differences over the same facts and the same decision (order, punctuation, connectives, extra explanation inside the cause field). It may never cover a missing required literal, a missing fix= field, a wrong number or identifier, a different decision label, or an explanation that contradicts a registered fact.
track_B_semantic.reporting_rule: if track B passes while track A fails, the result must be reported as 'strict track not met; semantic track passed (wording difference)' and never as 'quality unchanged'

stage_A_record_run.purpose: obtain the task's real recorded model inputs and per-source output hashes; it contains no plugin arm and therefore produces no plugin cost or quality information

conditions: the zero-API rebuild reproduces every recorded boundary (structure, tool-item contiguity, per-output SHA256 and char counts); no self-made stub may be used

every plugin item is recomputable: kept items are byte-identical to the original, and a pointer equals '[Exact duplicate output; full source is at call_id=<newest call_id>; sha256=<source sha256>]' whose target full copy is still present later in the same payload
the replaced-position set equals the set of positions whose recorded hash/length differs from the baseline arm

fact presence is fail-closed: any required literal whose presence drops to zero on the reduced side fails the gate, and the negative control (replacing a unique evidence item with a pointer) must be reported as a lost fact

stage_C_matrix.mechanism: exact_duplicate_output_v12 (frozen v12 code, hashes recorded before Stage A)
stage_C_matrix.acceptance_line: track A plugin quality >= baseline AND paired complete-total provider-token saving >= 3%
failure_lines: tool pairing, item count or item order broken

required_before_freeze: Stage 0: acquire instance.json and the public baseline source at base_commit, record every file SHA256
freeze pattern_A, the required/forbidden literal tables and the view line ranges
freeze the read protocol text, model, budgets, request cap, failure lines and data_class
Stage A: bounded single-arm record run producing the real payload records
zero-API replay gate green, including the negative control
write the final freeze once under a new id, and record the freeze file's own SHA256 in the batch manifest
